target: There is an absolute C such that for every integer n>=2 and every compact convex K in R^n with nonempty interior there is a full-rank lattice Lambda with K+Lambda=R^n and ess sup_x sum_{v in Lambda} 1_K(x-v) <= C n log(n+1).
